title: EvidenceRef
description: Liuye 5-protocol member · EvidenceRef (v3 spec §2.4 line 237-247). Evidence chain reference · points to a KBDoc.id + excerpt span. freshness 3-state (fresh/critical/expired) is the v3 contract enum · DIFFERENT from shared/evidence_freshness.classify_freshness() 5-band UI labels (fresh/recent/aging/stale/very_stale) · mapping done at consumer adapter (fresh→fresh · recent→fresh · aging→critical · stale→critical · very_stale→expired). decision_id added per P0-8 R9 · only set when EvidenceRef directly supports a cross-decision link (LE-05 sign-off lookup) · NOT for in-artifact backing (use Artifact.evidence_refs[] for that).

id.description: Stable EvidenceRef identifier · referenced by Artifact.evidence_refs[] and message citations.

schema_version.description: Liuye contract schema version · fixed '1' for the current spec lock.

kb_doc_id.description: Parent KBDoc.id this evidence excerpt comes from. Resolves to a kb_doc.schema.json instance.

excerpt.description: Quoted excerpt text (v3 §2.4 line 240 verbatim · per appendix C: length cap and PII redaction policy applied). Shown in evidence drawer panel.

start.description: Excerpt start offset (character index) within the parent KBDoc content.

end.description: Excerpt end offset (character index) within the parent KBDoc content. end > start.

span.description: Character span within parent KBDoc · used for re-highlighting in source viewer.

freshness.description: Freshness 3-state (v3 §2.4 line 242 verbatim). fresh = within SLA per claim_type (root §3.5.1 FRESHNESS_SLA_DAYS · e.g. news 180d) · critical = near SLA boundary (warn but usable) · expired = past SLA (block as core_claim per recommendation_schema.staleness_policy_passed=false · background only). NOTE: this is contract-layer 3-enum · NOT the 5-band UI classification from shared/evidence_freshness.classify_freshness() (fresh/recent/aging/stale/very_stale) · adapter at consumer side.

data_tier.description: Data tier 1-4 (v3 §2.4 line 243 verbatim · same as KBDoc.tier). Cached here for fast filter without joining KBDoc. Must equal parent kb_doc.tier · consumer verifies at sanity check.

related_artifact_ids.description: Artifact.id list · all artifacts whose snapshot is backed by this evidence (v3 §2.4 line 244).

cite_in_message_ids.description: Message.id list · chat messages that inline-cite this evidence (v3 §2.4 line 245). Footnote-style citation map in conversation view.

decision_id.description: Optional · P0-8 R9. Cross-decision link · set ONLY when this evidence directly supports a decision_ledger entry (LE-05 sign-off lookup target). For normal in-artifact backing use related_artifact_ids[] instead · NOT decision_id. Mapping case matrix to be ratified separately.

evidence_date.description: ISO 8601 UTC · event occurrence date for this evidence (NOT fetched_at · NOT collected_at). Per root §3.5.1 第 6 原则 hardline: evidence missing evidence_date cannot serve as core claim. Maps to recommendation_schema.evidence_date semantics.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC · when we retrieved this evidence excerpt. Distinct from KBDoc.collected_at (whole-doc fetch) · this is excerpt-level retrieval timestamp.

source_url.description: Optional · source URL (e.g. https://www.cbirc.gov.cn/...) or internal source identifier (internal://crm/holdings). Mirrors recommendation_schema.source_url semantics. URI-reference allows both http(s) and internal:// pseudo-scheme.

source_tier.description: Optional · matches shared/data_tiers.DataTier str enum verbatim. When set must be consistent with data_tier int (1↔internal_authoritative · 2↔government · 3↔industry · 4↔public_web · unknown defaults to tier 4 handling).
